thread:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PROD-metrics-pipeline - Prometheus scrape failure spike (firing)
Ben O'Connor: acked oncall. I'm on it. Looking at prometheus scrape logs now.
Ryan SRE: thx ben. any customer impact visible?
Ben O'Connor: dashboards show ~30% scrape_missing for collector-exporter in eu-west1. logs show intermittent 504s hitting exporter.
Maria Nguyen: reassign to me if it's exporter cluster. I can ssh into the node and check.
incidentbot: PagerDuty incident PD-4821 created, severity: P2. Assigned to Ben O'Connor. Acknowledged by Ben O'Connor.
Ben O'Connor: ran `kubectl get pods -n metrics -l app=exporter -o wide` shows 2/5 restarts on exporter-xx.
Ben O'Connor: tail of exporter logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:03:10Z ERROR http: upstream 10.12.34.56: GET /metrics -> 504 timeout
2026-03-15T12:04:05Z WARN scrape: target eu-west1-collector response slow 3.2s
```
Ben O'Connor: bumping scrape timeout to 5s temporarily. patch:
```
prometheus_scrape_config:
  scrape_timeout: 5s
```
Maria Nguyen: I'll cordon one exporter node and restart pods. `kubectl rollout restart ds/exporter -n metrics`
Katie Support: FYI we've got two customers with increased error rates on ingest: cust-a and cust-b showing missing metrics alerts. Notified support.
Maria Nguyen: restarted exporter DaemonSet, monitoring.
Ryan SRE: logs ingestion looks backpressured too - kafka consumer lag increasing. Could be root cause (exporter timeouts causing scrape retries, backlog).
Ben O'Connor: scaling up ingestion consumers by +3. `kubectl scale deployment kafka-consumer -n ingest --replicas=8`
Ben O'Connor: also enabling prefix cache fallback for heavy probes to reduce load.
incidentbot: Auto-note: PD incident updated - status: mitigating. responders: Ben, Maria, Ryan.
Maria Nguyen: after restart, exporter pod restarts dropped. scrape_missing down from 30% to 6% in eu-west1.
Katie Support: sending proactive message to customers: "We're seeing transient metric gaps in EU region, mitigation in progress. We'll update in 30m." :email:
Ben O'Connor: kafka lag still trending; consumer CPU saturated on 2 nodes. Scaling worked, lag decreasing.
Ryan SRE: opened follow-up ticket to investigate exporter memory leak and kafka throttling. `GH-1245`
Maria Nguyen: leaving oncall to Ben in 20m. Ben: can you own the post-incident review (impact analysis + runbook updates)?
Ben O'Connor: will do. planning blamestorming session 1pm PST.
incidentbot: PD-4821 resolved: condition cleared. Please close when you have RCA.
Ben O'Connor: incident declared resolved. I'll collect logs and draft RCA.
Katie Support: customers updated — no escalations.
Maria Nguyen: thanks team. moving to follow-ups: increase exporter scrape timeout default to 7s, add exporter liveness probe tuning, and add runbook step for kafka-consumer autoscale thresholds.
Ben O'Connor: adding a synthetic alert to catch exporter 5xx spike before scrape_missing reaches 20%.
Ryan SRE: +1 to synthetic alert. Also will schedule load test on exporter cluster next week.
Maria Nguyen: tagging GH-1245 and assigning to infra for memory profiling.
Ben O'Connor: wrapping up. timeline and next steps will be in the RCA doc.
